title: Large one-off property deposit from a long-standing customer
summary: A customer with eleven years of history transferred a very large sum to a solicitor's client account for a house purchase. The amount was far outside their normal range.
signals: the amount is many times this customer's usual payment
the money is going to a receiver never used before
the sender still has money left afterwards
the payment was made during normal hours
resolution: Customer confirmed by OTP within seconds. Payment completed.
lesson: A large unusual amount is not fraud on its own. Long history plus a partial balance plus normal hours point to a genuine life event. Confirm, do not block.
